label: Origami Metamaterials Based on Low-Melting-Point Alloy Phase Transition: Breaking the Trade-Off Between Reusability and Energy Absorption Quality.
summary: Mechanical metamaterials provide a promising platform for designing energy-absorbing materials. However, the trade-off between reusability and energy absorption quality limits the overall performance of existing energy-absorbing metamaterials. To address this challenge, an origami metamaterial based on the low-melting-point alloy phase transition is proposed in this study, constructed by integrating a low-melting-point alloy skeleton into an elastomeric shell.
